summary.text: Reagan Paul is a Republican member of the Maine House of Representatives who has represented District 37 since December 6, 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A small business owner from Winterport, she is running against Alan Orcutt (D).

paragraphs.text: Reagan Paul was born in Maine and lives in Winterport.
She earned bachelor's degrees in Christian entrepreneurship and digital marketing/advertising from Liberty University in 2020.
Her career experience includes working as a small business owner and partner in a telecom consulting company.
Paul first took office in the House in December 2022.
She was assigned to the Bills in the Second Reading Committee and the Energy, Utilities and Technology Committee in 2023-2024, and to the Elections Committee in 2025-2026.
She advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
